rationale: The phone was accidentally damaged during your covered trip, and the repair report confirms it cannot be repaired, so this is covered under section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects). Because the Economy plan has no Electronics Plus add-on, the per-item limit is $150, so we count the phone at $150 rather than the $1,099 replacement cost, then take off the $100 Economy deductible (section 10 and claims manual section 6). That leaves $50, which is under the $750 baggage maximum.
